identity: A helmet fit with a transparent full-face mask.  On the back of the helmet is a long tube which attaches to a powered air purifying respirator system.  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  Like a standard gas mask it must be prepared before use; unlike a standard gas mask, it is relatively cool and comfortable, but will only function when paired with an active PAPR blower unit.

identity:
Dr. Liu,
Based on these preliminary results, I'm afraid there is no other option than to seek XEDRA-external candidates.  We've run every single employee at site 2 through the resonance detector and none of them came up higher than Minor, with most not even registering at all.  The capability to understand and manipulate dimensional metaphysics seems limited to a small fraction of the population, and until we can figure some way to affect that it means that our mathematician pool is extremely and unacceptably limited.  As such, I propose that we begin limited screening from among other government employees and, if necessary, among the general population.

I recognize the security concerns inherent in this suggestion, but until we can convince the other XEDRA divisions to allow us to screen all of their employees or otherwise find a large pool of cleared candidates, recruitment is going to be the only option.
Joshua Sanders
Lead Researcher, AZURE SONNET
